title: バイオ・化学基礎実験・演習A(応用バイオ)
subtitle: Basic Experiments and Practice in Bioscience and Chemistry A (Applied Bioscience)
educationalGoal: The aim of this course is to provide freshman/sophomore-level students with the conceptual framework, factual knowledge, and analytical skills necessary to deal critically with the rapidly changing science of biology and to understand measurement techniques in the field of biology and applications of biology, including electrical circuits for making amplifiers and measuring human hearing abilities with audiometers.
advice: The aim of this course is to provide freshman/sophomore-level students with the conceptual framework, factual knowledge, and analytical skills necessary to deal critically with the rapidly changing science of biology and to understand measurement techniques in the field of biology and applications of biology. The coursework is done via a series of basic laboratory exercises. Students are required to attend all classes. Students shall inform their instructors of dates they will miss class due to an excused absence prior to the date of that anticipated absence. There are no exams, but students are required to write laboratory reports.
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of electrical circuits, physics, and human physiology.

activityGoals.body: Describe the basic mechanism of amplification

Writing skills for scientific and technological reports
